question: If (y + z) = 25 and (y² - z²) = 225, what is the value of z?
solution:
**Given:**

(y + z) = 25 .......(1)

(y2 - z2) = 225

**Concept used:**

x² - y² = (x + y)(x - y)

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

(y2 - z2) = 225

⇒ (y + z) × (y - z) = 225

⇒ (25) × (y - z) = 225

⇒ (y - z) = 9 .........(2)

Subtracting (2) from (1)

⇒ (y + z) - (y - z) = 25 - 9 

⇒ 2z = 16

⇒ z = 8

**∴ The value of z is 8.**
